```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

read intermediates
```{r}
ps4_a <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp4/intermediates/ps4_a.rds")

ps4_b <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp4/intermediates/ps4_b.rds")
ps4_c <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp4/intermediates/ps4_c.rds")
ps4_d <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp4/intermediates/ps4_d.rds")

ps4_e <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp4/intermediates/ps4_e.rds")
ps4_f <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp4/intermediates/ps4_f.rds")
ps4_g <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/4_answer_only/intermediates/rev1/ont_pb_overlap_matching.rds")

```


```{r}
# Space for panel letters above the plots.
panel_margin <- theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))

# Rebuild b/c from the individual plots, without their old panel letters.
ps4_b_c <- plot_grid(ps4_b + panel_margin, ps4_c + panel_margin, ncol = 1, labels = c("b", "c"), label_size = 7,
                     label_x = 0, label_y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1)

s4_top_row <- plot_grid(ps4_a + panel_margin, ps4_b_c, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, 1), labels = c("a", ""), label_size = 7,
  label_x = 0, label_y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1)

ps4_d_fixed <- ps4_d_fixed +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1), fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal")
ps4_d_aligned <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_plot(ps4_d_fixed, x = -0.07, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1)

# Put the long clonotype identifier in the figure legend
ps4_e_fixed <- ps4_e_fixed +
  labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal")

s4_d_g_hd <- plot_grid(ps4_d_aligned, ps4_g + panel_margin, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.9), labels = c("d", "g"),
  label_size = 7, label_x = 0, label_y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1)

s4_e_f_hd <- plot_grid(ps4_e_fixed, ps4_f + panel_margin,
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.55, 1), labels = c("e", "f"), label_size = 7,
  label_x = 0, label_y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1)

s4_bot <- plot_grid(s4_d_g_hd, s4_e_f_hd, ncol = 2)

s4_full <- plot_grid(s4_top_row, s4_bot, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(3, 6.5)) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=9}
s4_full
```


```{r}
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/s4_ratio.pdf", plot=s4_full, width = 8, height = 9)
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/s4_ratio.png", plot=s4_full, width = 8, height = 9)
```
